constraints.statement: Label length for the P1 two-button row: user asked to record "about 2 Chinese characters (inner width 18)".
constraints.measured: 2-char labels (text width 28) give 130/130 in the existing example (older Active without icons). In M1 (current Active with icons), 2-char labels (28) and 4-char labels (56) both give 131/129. Nominal inner width 130 - 112 = 18 is already exceeded by 2 characters, so the 18 figure does not explain the limit.
constraints.conclusion: No confirmed character limit. Label length did not change the result in M1; the icons in the current Active variant are the likely factor.
constraints.hypothesis: The two icons in the current Active variant change the FILL split; not proven by experiment.

baseline: bl-001 Button has no TEXT property; labels set via inner text override (overriddenFields: characters, styledTextSegments)
bl-002 Button colours are not bound to variables (only Stroke/Border, Space/400 bound)
